subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hanging by a thread.

options.text: To be perilously close to falling, dying, or resulting in a bad outcome

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Hanging by a thread"** means to be in a very precarious or dangerous situation, where failure or disaster is imminent. (खतरे में होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The company is hanging by a thread due to its financial troubles.
 
 
 
• **Option 1:** To be perilously close to falling, dying, or resulting in a bad outcome accurately captures the meaning of the idiom. (खतरे के बहुत करीब होना)
 
 
• **Example:** After the accident, his life was hanging by a thread as doctors struggled to save him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Crude and lacking sophistication (साधारण और परिष्कार की कमी)

 
 
• **Example:** His behavior was crude and lacked any sense of refinement.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** To do something very risky (बहुत जोखिम भरा कार्य करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Skydiving without proper training is a very risky thing to do.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** To avoid danger or trouble (खतरे या परेशानी से बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** By leaving the party early, he managed to avoid trouble.
 
 

f4:Tc52,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
